widgets_values:
WAN Latent Trim Start: cut frames off the START of a WAN video latent, before the VAE decode - cheaper and cleaner than cutting decoded frames.
The count is in PIXEL frames. WAN's VAE packs 4 frames into one latent frame (T latent frames decode to 4T-3), so the count is snapped to the nearest multiple of 4 and `removed_frames` tells you what really went; `frames_left` is what the trimmed latent will decode to.
In a real workflow put it between the sampler and VAE Decode. This example needs no model: an empty 81-frame latent (21 latent frames) is trimmed by 10 -> 12 frames removed, 69 left.
Not for LTX-Video (8x) or Mochi (6x) latents: their time compression differs.
